coordinate_definition.q_front_raw: MuJoCo left front active joint jIJ raw qpos, right-hand positive about its hinge axis, rad
coordinate_definition.q_rear_raw: MuJoCo left rear active joint jIO raw qpos, right-hand positive about its hinge axis, rad
coordinate_definition.front_rear_meaning: anatomical/XML linkage branches, not vehicle driving direction
coordinate_definition.raw_q_positive: right-hand positive about local hinge axis (0,-1,0); in the local X-Z drawing, +X rotates toward +Z
coordinate_definition.s_W: signed wheel displacement along +base Y in the leg side-view plane; legacy report name x_H
coordinate_definition.d_W: signed wheel displacement toward chassis down, equal to -base Z
coordinate_definition.controller_drive_x_relation: main_mujoco controller x = -s_W direction for the audited nominal base orientation
coordinate_definition.L0: distance from coaxial hip axis to wheel axis, m
coordinate_definition.theta_leg: atan2(s_W, d_W), positive from chassis down toward +base Y, rad
coordinate_definition.phi0: pi/2 - theta_leg = atan2(d_W, s_W), controller virtual-leg polar angle, rad

grid_domain: L0=0.15..0.42 m in 0.01 m steps; phi0=70..110 deg in 5 deg steps
